messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — planning to flip feature_flag "prefetch_v2" from safe-default OFF -> ON at 23:00 UTC in the quiet window tonight. Target: 10% US traffic. Who's owning rollout + smoke?
Sam: I can own the flip. @Tess would you take smoke validation and logs?
Tess: Yep, I can do smoke. What are the exact steps I should run?
Sam: Short checklist: 1) run the smoke script against canary nodes, 2) confirm p95 latency < 200ms, 3) ensure error rate delta < 0.1%, 4) validate fallback when flag is forced OFF.
Sam: Smoke command (prod canary):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/prefetch -H \"Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN\" -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}'
```
Eli: Note: keep safe-defaults enforced for unknown tenants. Also ensure the kill-switch path in config-gate is ready: `feature_flags.prefetch_v2 = off` in vault.
Maya: I'll add the kill-switch path to the runbook and tag the ops page. Deploy-bot — can you schedule the flip for 23:00 UTC and enable the rollback hook?
deploy-bot: Scheduled flip for 1718891400 (23:00 UTC). Canary: 10% US. Rollback hook enabled. Runbook: https://intranet/redwood/runbooks/prefetch_v2
Tess: I'll validate the canary at ~23:05 and post results here by 23:12.
Sam: I'll be on standby on the pager during the window. Rule of thumb: if p95 > 250ms or error rate > 0.2% -> immediate rollback.
Maya: Rollback command is just: `/ops rollback-flag prefetch_v2` — I added it to the runbook with explicit criteria and owner.
Eli: Also please add temporary log tag `pf2-canary` (or `pf2=canary`) in the request metadata so we can filter quickly in logs/tracing.
Tess: ack :thumbsup: will add the tag and run smoke.
deploy-bot: Status update (1718891100): Canary rolling to 10% US now. No fatal errors on startup traces.
Tess: 23:08 smoke results: p95=120ms, avg=60ms, error rate=0.03%. Prefetch keys present, no cache-thrash seen.
Sam: Looks good so far. Hold for 30m, if stable we can move to 50% after 23:40.
Maya: Thanks all — I'll update the PR and the release notes with the rollout plan and rollback steps.
Tess: Posting logs and short screenshot of tracing filter once I finish.
Sam: Great. If anything spikes, call rollback immediately.
Maya: Closing loop: owner=Sam, smoke=Tess, kill-switch=Eli, deploy-sched=deploy-bot.
